title: ABOUT
body: Lumina Drops makes small, deliberate collections for the hours after midnight. Each drop is a single boxed ritual — candles, glassware, and the small ceremonies that turn an ordinary evening into one you remember.

facts.detail: Every drop is a fixed run. No restocks, ever.
A few drops a year, each built around one night.
Objects meant to outlast the evening they were made for.
